程序包 top.brmc.bukkitplatform.mobarena.arena

类 ArenaScoreboard

java.lang.Object
top.brmc.devlib.model.SimpleScoreboard
top.brmc.bukkitplatform.mobarena.arena.ArenaScoreboard
public class ArenaScoreboard extends top.brmc.devlib.model.SimpleScoreboard
竞技场侧边栏计分板, 负责展示单个玩家的击杀数, 竞技场金币与对局时长.

继承 SimpleScoreboard 的定时刷新机制, 每次刷新时按 ScoreboardSettings.LINES 的行模板替换占位符后重新渲染. 每个玩家对应一个实例, 由 Arena.setPlayerScoreboard(org.bukkit.entity.Player, top.brmc.bukkitplatform.mobarena.arena.ArenaScoreboard) 注册与回收.
